description: Search JCL vehicle inventory with full pricing. ALWAYS searches ALL J.C. Lewis stores (Savannah, Pooler, Hinesville, Statesboro, Lincoln) — J.C. Lewis cross-sells between locations, so a vehicle at another store is still available to the customer. The `store` argument is only a PREFERENCE that shows that store's vehicles first; it never hides the other stores. Accepts a stock number (e.g. 'F6094'), VIN, or model name (e.g. 'F-150', 'Explorer'). Make prefixes are stripped automatically — 'Ford F-150' and 'F-150' both work, as do common variants like 'F150'. Condition accepts NEW, USED, or CPO/CERTIFIED to filter certified pre-owned vehicles. Optional filters: min_year, max_year, min_price, max_price. Optional sort: 'discount_desc' ranks ALL matches by biggest dealer discount off MSRP (MSRP minus dealer_discounted_price) before applying the limit — use this when the customer asks for the best deal or biggest savings. Every result also includes discount_off_msrp (dollar amount) and discount_pct (percentage off MSRP). Returns MSRP, sale price, incentives, rebates, dealer fee, and the store each vehicle is at. The `total` field is the REAL number of matches across all stores (may exceed `returned`); `returned` is how many are in this response. Always tell the customer which location a vehicle is at, and NEVER tell them a J.C. Lewis location does not exist.
name: search_inventory
